title: Soul Feast #26 – Am I Joyful or Am I Happy?
excerpt: Many people use the words “joy” and “happiness” interchangeably, but are they really the same?
bodyHtml:
Many people use the words “joy” and “happiness” interchangeably, but are they really the same? In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav explores the profound difference between the fleeting highs of happiness—driven by external circumstances—and the deep, unwavering presence of joy.

While happiness is tied to the temporary satisfaction of our fears and desires, joy arises from something much deeper: the alignment of our personality with our soul.

At the heart of this conversation is the concept of authentic power—choosing love over fear, even when fear is present. Gary breaks down how happiness is dependent on the external world, fluctuating with life’s ups and downs, while joy is an unshakable state of being that emerges when we move beyond fear-based reactions. 

By recognizing and challenging the frightened parts of our personality, we can cultivate lasting joy rather than chasing momentary happiness.

The key to experiencing true joy is to practice emotional awareness, learning to distinguish between fearful and loving parts of our personality. When we act from love—choosing gratitude, patience, and appreciation—we step into our authentic power and free ourselves from the illusion that external circumstances define our well-being. 

Joy is our natural state; it is always available when we choose to see beyond fear.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (02:05) — The fundamental difference between happiness and joy
  • (07:42) — Why happiness is dependent on external circumstances and how it leads to suffering
  • (12:30) — How joy arises from within and remains unaffected by life’s ups and downs
  • (17:15) — The role of emotional awareness in recognizing fear-based reactions
  • (22:04) — How to create authentic power by choosing love over fear
  • (28:18) — Practical steps to shift from seeking happiness to experiencing joy

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge: Reflect on the moments in your life when you felt happy versus when you felt truly joyful. Was your happiness tied to a specific event, person, or outcome? Did it fade when circumstances changed? Now, recall a moment of joy—one that felt deeply fulfilling and was not dependent on anything external. This week, observe your emotions: Are you chasing happiness, or are you choosing joy? The path to joy begins with recognizing when fear is present and consciously shifting toward love.
